title: Ham radio contest log with running score and band activity
summary: A fictional five-contact contest log with explicit scoring and duplicate handling.

blocks.heading: Practice contest · 09:00–09:35 UTC
blocks.body: Invented scoring: each unique station-band contact earns one point; each unique region earns one multiplier across the whole contest. Score = valid contact points × distinct regions. These are teaching rules, not the rules of any real contest. Station IDs and regions below are fictional.

blocks.heading: Running score
blocks.caption: Static worked log. It does not accept entries, hear radio traffic or recalculate when you click.

blocks.heading: Band activity in this sample
blocks.caption: This tiny log cannot establish which band has better propagation; operating time and search effort are not controlled.

blocks.heading: Add a hypothetical contact
blocks.prompt: At 09:40, SIM-D in East is worked on 20 m. What is the new score?
blocks.explanation: It is a new station-band contact, so points increase to five. East is already in the region set, so multipliers stay at three.
